title: John Mckinley, British - Arrested In Kobe In Connection With Ammunition Shipment

page_data.en:
863
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & B. REGISTRY
May 6, 1933
Mr. D HISH
I 15 p33

THE CHINA WEEKLY REVIEW

British Subject Arrested in Kobe in Connection
with Ammunition Shipment

Recent papers from Japan state that a British subject
John McKinley, was arrested by the Kobe water police
April 27 as he was about to leave for Shanghai. It is
alleged that the man arrested is the "mysterious for-
eigner" sought for in connection with a transhipment
of ammunition from a Dutch steamer to a Japanese
steamer bound for China. The paper also alleges that
Mr. McKinley is involved in the sale of a certain steamer,
and that he was handed Yen 23,000 as an advance on
the purchase price of Yen 100,000. The Shanghai police
have no record of a man of this name.

J. C. (bane)
defamation.
J. McEwen

O. i/c Sp. Br.
MAY 6 1933

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER : MAY 8 1933 (CRIME BRANCH)）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与保安科登记处
1933年5月6日

致 D HISH 先生
I 15 p33

《密勒氏评论报》

英国侨民因涉及弹药装运案在神户被捕

日本近日报刊称，英国侨民约翰·麦金莱（John McKinley）于4月27日在准备前往上海时，被神户水上警察逮捕。据称，该被捕男子即为因涉及将一批弹药从一艘荷兰轮船转运至一艘驶往中国的日本轮船一案而遭通缉的“神秘外国人”。该报还称，麦金莱先生卷入某艘轮船的买卖交易，并作为10万日元购船款的预付款，收取了2.3万日元。上海警方并无此姓名人员的记录。

J. C. (bane)
诽谤。
J. McEwen

特别科科长
1933年5月6日

（印：副总监：1933年5月8日（刑事科））
